gizmo.title: Pāʻani huakaʻi manaʻo
gizmo.description: He honua e ʻauwana ai. Loaʻa nā manaʻo iā ʻoe a nīnau mai. E pane pololei e lanakila a wehe i kona hale. Hōʻike ka hōʻuluʻulu i nā hoʻāʻo a me ka mea e nānā hou ai.

configure.title: Huakaʻi
configure.description: Ke koi e hōʻike ʻia ma ka pale hoʻomaka. E haʻi i ka mea pāʻani i ke kumu o ka huakaʻi.

configure.title: Nā manaʻo
configure.description: He hale kēlā me kēia manaʻo me kekahi monster.

configure.title: Kapa waena
configure.description: Ka manaʻo i hui pū ʻia e nā manaʻo a pau.

configure.title: Ma hope o ka pāʻani
configure.description: Koho. Hoʻololi i ka pahu kope koi ma ka papa hoʻopau me kāu ʻike ponoʻī, e like me ka hana aʻe a i ʻole he loulou.

configure.title: Nā pihi hou ma hope o ka pāʻani
configure.description: Koho. Nā pihi a i ʻole nā loulou i hōʻike ʻia ma ka ʻaoʻao o E pāʻani hou ma ka papa hoʻopau.

advanced.title: Nā puʻuwai
advanced.description: Nā pane hewa ma mua o ka pakele ʻana o ka manaʻo.

advanced.title: Hua o ke kanaka
advanced.description: Kekahi ʻōlelo. Hana mau ka hua like i ke kanaka like. ʻO ia ka hua like a ka avatar HAX e hoʻohana ai.

advanced.title: E hoʻohana i ke kanaka o ka mea i komo
advanced.description: Inā komo kekahi i HAX, e like ke kanaka me kā lākou avatar ponoʻī. ʻIke nā mea ʻē aʻe i ka hua ma luna.

advanced.title: Laina ma luna o ke koi
advanced.description: E waiho ʻole no ka laina maʻamau.

advanced.title: Koi e kope ai
advanced.description: Hōʻike ʻia ma ka papa hoʻopau me ke pihi kope. E holoi e hūnā i ka pahu.

advanced.title: Inoa pāʻani
advanced.description: Hoʻohua i ka inoa o kēia pāʻani ma nā hanana holomua a me ka māka OER Schema.

advanced.title: ID pāʻani
advanced.description: Koho. Hoʻokaʻawale i kēia pāʻani mai nā mea ʻē aʻe ma ka ʻaoʻao ma nā hanana holomua.
